5587.title: [Build] Backport Windows SDK ANGLE resource compiler to 4.155
5587.body:
Backport mono/SkiaSharp#5537 (f515dd58d9782a208a569532512db736838c7a22) to release/4.155.x.

Replace the Chromium GCS rc.exe download with the reviewed rc.py patch, preserving preprocessing and dependency tracking. Retain the servicing branch file IO helpers because its Cake version does not expose FileReadText/FileWriteText. Validate patch shape and avoid rewriting unchanged files.

Validated: dotnet cake native/winui-angle/build.cake --dryrun; exact production patch against Chromium build a18493935f13d1b0992c78f5615a5d10336d60c0 rc.py, Python compilation, repeated application without writes, and malformed-input rejection. Windows native compilation unavailable on macOS; original Win ANGLE x86/x64/arm64 success in AzDO 1657048 is historical evidence only.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
